info.name: TIP Email Manager - DEMO: full template lifecycle per recipient mode
info.description:
Happy-path demo of the whole lifecycle for each recipient mode: author -> approve -> edit -> approve -> restore -> approve -> retire -> approve -> reactivate -> approve -> version history.

Run one mode folder (or all four) in the Collection Runner. Each mode is independent and creates its own template.
Needs two different users: maker (author) and checker (approver; Sr. Analyst or Manager). Query: select ca_name, ca_type, status, email, name from em_contact where status=:status

Tip for the demo: after 'View the template's version history', open the Visualize tab to show the history as a table.
